title.rendered: Labour Colony in East Delhi — Prefab Worker Housing

content.rendered:
Arranging worker accommodation on East Delhi’s compact, congested construction sites is rarely simple. In areas like Shahdara, Mayur Vihar, and Laxmi Nagar, plots are tight, access is narrow, and project timelines leave little room for slow site-built sheds. A factory-built labour colony in East Delhi solves this: SAMAN Portable manufactures modular, MS-frame worker housing that arrives ready to install, fits constrained urban footprints, and meets basic worker-welfare needs from day one.

SAMAN manufactures and dispatches labour colony units directly from our Greater Noida facility (Jalpura, PIN 201308) — factory-to-site delivery across Delhi NCR without middlemen. East Delhi sites — Patparganj, Jhilmil and Shahdara — are a short NCR dispatch from the same plant.

As a direct manufacturer — serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019 (POS = Portable Office Solutions) — we build to IS 2062 structural steel under ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015 and ISO 45001 systems, with 500+ projects delivered across India and NSIC and DPIIT recognition. Our portable labour hutments and prefab labour camp blocks carry a warranty of 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. Large sites are expected to provide suitable worker accommodation under the Building and Other Construction Workers (BOCW) Act and related state welfare rules, which cover sanitation, minimum space per worker, ventilation and fire safety — a planned colony supports these requirements.

SAMAN POS India Private Limited (brand SAMAN Portable) has been serving India since 2009, incorporated as SAMAN POS India Private Limited in 2019. Our North-India units are dispatched from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 factory, which serves all NCR localities including East Delhi — a direct factory-to-site supply route that keeps logistics short and accountable.

Why On-Site Worker Housing Matters in East Delhi

East Delhi’s ongoing infrastructure and building activity — metro-adjacent works, school and public construction, and residential developments — needs sizeable labour forces housed close to the work. But open land is scarce, and packing a worker camp into a dense urban plot demands a footprint-efficient, compliant solution. A prefab labour colony lets contractors house workers on-site without sprawling temporary structures.

On-site accommodation keeps the workforce close on space-tight East Delhi projects

Common East Delhi Site Challenges

  • Limited open space in dense areas like Shahdara and Laxmi Nagar
  • Worker-welfare and sanitation expectations to be met on-site
  • Tight project timelines needing fast deployment
  • Narrow access roads for delivery and installation
  • Balancing cost with durable, reusable housing

What Proper Worker Housing Delivers

  • Better worker retention and on-site productivity
  • Reduced daily commuting time and mobilisation delays
  • Improved site security for the workforce and equipment
  • More predictable project scheduling
  • A reusable asset that can be relocated to the next project

SAMAN’s Compact, Modular Worker Colonies

SAMAN Portable builds prefab labour colonies designed to make the most of constrained urban plots. Units are manufactured on an IS 2062 mild-steel (MS) frame with insulated PUF wall and roof panels (roughly 50–60mm), then transported and assembled on-site. The result is durable worker accommodation that fits tight footprints while keeping interiors usable through Delhi’s heat and monsoon.

Modular MS-frame units assembled on a constrained East Delhi plot

Space Optimisation

Units are dimensioned to maximise accommodation per square metre, suiting the constrained sites typical of Laxmi Nagar and Shahdara.

Stackable G+1 Design

Where height is permitted, a G+1 configuration adds capacity vertically without increasing the ground footprint — useful on the smallest plots.

Quick Site Setup

Because panels and frames are factory-built, on-site assembly is fast — most installs are completed within a few days of site preparation, minimising disruption.

SAMAN can supply and install prefab worker housing across East Delhi’s construction corridors. Explore the full prefabricated labour colony range to see standard module options.

Our modular units are built for East Delhi’s urban constraints and dispatched factory-direct from Greater Noida.

Build Specifications and Materials

Every SAMAN labour colony is built to consistent, manufacturer-grade specifications. The table below summarises the core build elements.

ElementSpecification
Structural frameIS 2062 mild-steel (MS) frame and base
Wall & roof panelsInsulated PUF panels, approx. 50–60mm
RoofingSlope GI roofing for monsoon drainage
WindowsSliding windows with provision for grilles
FlooringDurable, easy-clean floor finish
Railings (G+1)MS railings and external staircase

Performance Features

  • PUF insulation for heat control in Delhi summers
  • Weatherproof panel joints and slope roofing for monsoon
  • Fire-safety-conscious materials and layout
  • Energy-efficient envelope reducing cooling load

Warranty & Assurance

  • 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life
  • ISO 9001:2015 quality management
  • Returns within 7 days of delivery/installation
  • Factory-direct dispatch from Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308

Power, Water, and Sanitation — Integrated

SAMAN labour colonies for East Delhi sites can be supplied with integrated utilities so the camp is usable on handover, while meeting worker-welfare and hygiene expectations.

Modular sanitation block supplied with the labour colony

Utility Provisions

  • Pre-wired electrical points with safety provisions
  • Solar-ready rooftops where supplementary power helps
  • Water storage and distribution arrangements
  • Wastewater handling options
  • Dedicated cooking and dining space

Sanitation Options

  • Modular toilet and shower blocks
  • Septic provision where sewer access is limited
  • Handwashing and hygiene stations
  • Practical waste-management layout
  • Easy-clean finishes for upkeep

Worker Housing for Schools, Roads & Public Sites

SAMAN’s modular labour colonies adapt to a range of project types across East Delhi — from compact school and public-building sites to linear roadwork corridors — making them a flexible choice for contractors managing varied site conditions.

School & Public Building Sites

Compact, secure on-site accommodation for school construction and renovation work where plots are small and adjacent to occupied buildings.

Road & Infrastructure Works

Linear unit arrangements suited to roadwork along East Delhi’s congested transport corridors, where housing must follow a narrow strip.

Residential Developments

Scalable worker housing that can expand or contract across project phases for larger residential builds, then be relocated afterwards.

Planning a construction project in East Delhi?

Get a labour colony configured for your site type, plot size, and worker capacity.

Call +91 62009 09435 Send Enquiry

Customisation and Capacity Options

SAMAN offers practical customisation so the labour colony matches your East Delhi site rather than forcing a fixed layout. Module sizes, worker capacity per block, supervisor accommodation, amenity blocks, and security additions are all configurable.

Configuration OptionTypical Use
Worker moduleShared dormitory block, sized to required capacity
Supervisor blockSeparate accommodation for site supervisors
Amenity blockKitchen, dining, toilet and shower facilities
Multi-level (G+1)Vertical capacity on space-tight plots
Site-office attachmentIntegrated site office to save plot space

Security Enhancements

  • Reinforced doors and windows
  • Perimeter fencing options
  • Security cabin attachments
  • CCTV mounting provisions
  • Controlled access points

Functional Additions

  • Integrated site office
  • Tool storage extensions
  • First-aid / medical room
  • Communal kitchen
  • Recreation space

Comfort Upgrades

  • Enhanced insulation for temperature control
  • Improved ventilation
  • Upgraded flooring
  • Better lighting
  • Privacy partitioning

From Design to Handover: How It Works

SAMAN’s deployment process is built to keep your construction timeline on track, with factory-built units arriving ready for fast on-site assembly.

  • Consultation – We discuss your site, capacity needs, and timeline to scope the right configuration.
  • Site Assessment – We evaluate the East Delhi plot for access, footprint, and any height or compliance constraints.
  • Proposal & Design – A tailored layout and quotation are prepared for your plot dimensions and worker count.
  • Manufacturing – Units are fabricated to specification at our Greater Noida factory while site prep proceeds.
  • Delivery & Installation – Modules are transported to site and assembled by our team, typically within a few days.
  • Handover – Utilities are connected and checked, and the colony is inspected before handover for use.

    FAQs: Labour Colony in East Delhi


    How long does it take to install a labour colony in East Delhi?

    Because the units are factory-built, on-site assembly is fast — most installations are completed within a few days of site preparation. Exact time depends on capacity, configuration, and site access in your part of East Delhi.


    How much does a prefab labour colony cost?

    Pricing is on request and quote-based. The cost depends on worker capacity, single-storey vs G+1, amenity and sanitation blocks, and site conditions. Share your requirements and we will prepare a tailored quotation.


    Where are SAMAN’s labour colonies dispatched from for East Delhi?

    NCR orders, including East Delhi, are dispatched factory-direct from our Jalpura, Greater Noida 201308 unit. This keeps the supply route short and accountable from manufacturing to installation.


    What warranty do you provide?

    SAMAN provides 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. Units are built on an IS 2062 MS frame under ISO 9001:2015 quality management.


    Can the colony fit a compact or narrow East Delhi plot?

    Yes. Layouts are configurable, including linear arrangements for narrow strips and G+1 stacking where height is permitted, so capacity can be added vertically without increasing the ground footprint.


    How is worker capacity decided?

    Capacity is sized to your headcount and plot. Module sizes, supervisor blocks, and amenity blocks are configured around the number of workers and the space available, then confirmed during the site assessment.

    Certifications and Manufacturer Credentials

    SAMAN POS India Private Limited (POS = Portable Office Solutions) has manufactured steel labour colony units since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects across India from our plants at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 and Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, Greater Noida, Gautambudha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh 201308). Certifications and registrations: ISO 9001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (Cert No. E20250218646), ISO 45001:2018 (Cert No. E20250218647), NSIC enlisted (Ref. NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207), DPIIT-recognised startup (Ref. DIPP56005), Udyam registered (UDYAM-KR-03-0172770), GST 29ABBCS7101B1ZR (Bangalore) and 09ABBCS7101B1ZT (Noida). IS 2062 MS frame with insulated PUF panels. See our portable labour hutments or the full labour colony range.
